description: Nuvio plugin repository: Toonix (toonix.bond) — TV/anime streams via the site's own streams API (SORA + Legacy servers).
name: Toonix

scrapers.description: Streams from Toonix (toonix.bond): TV shows and anime through the site's own streams API — SORA server (480p/360p MP4) and Legacy server (direct archive.org MP4).
scrapers.name: Toonix

scrapers.description: Streams from DoFlix: movies and TV via the DoFlix app's own sources — Fast direct file links (Cloudflare R2, playable) and SuperStream HLS (TV + select titles). Direct download links are excluded: their host does not support seeking, so the player cannot play them.
scrapers.name: DoFlix

scrapers.description: Streams from CineCat (cinecat.eu): movies and TV via the site's own sources API — first-party HLS streams (servers abyssinia, calico, zanzibar, garfield).
scrapers.name: CineCat
